import numpy as np
idx=np.argsort(P)
print(np.round(np.c_[t,P,dP_dt][:15],4))
# crude fits
A=np.c_[np.ones_like(P),P,P**2,t,t*P,t**2]
c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
print(c, np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
print(np.corrcoef(np.c_[t,P,dP_dt].T))

o=np.argsort(P)
for i in o[::15]: print(round(P[i],3), round(t[i],2), round(dP_dt[i],4), round(dP_dt[i]/P[i],3))
# fit P-only spline-ish: polynomial in P
for d in [2,3,4,5]:
    B=np.vander(P,d+1)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    print(d, np.mean((B@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt))

B=np.vander(P,6)
c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
print(np.round(c,4))
xs=np.array([0,0.1,0.3,0.5,1,2,3,4,5,6.])
print(np.round(np.vander(xs,6)@c,3))
print(P.min(),P.max())

B=np.vander(P,6)
c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
r=dP_dt-B@c
best=[]
for w in np.linspace(0.05,5,1000):
    X=np.c_[np.ones_like(t),np.sin(w*t),np.cos(w*t)]
    cc=np.linalg.lstsq(X,r,rcond=None)[0]
    best.append((np.sum((X@cc-r)**2)/np.sum(r**2),w))
best.sort(); print(best[:5])
# also check residual vs P*t interaction
X=np.c_[B, B*t[:,None]]
c2=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
